recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce the older Parameters-string wrapper wording for JSON/XML Patch; use the current FHIRPath Patch Parameters and JSON Patch Binary guidance. Handle any PATCH-history inconsistency through the existing FHIR-19620/FHIR-34388 human-review trail.
issue_request: FHIR-13644 asked FHIR-I to add PATCH to Bundle.entry.request.method and to document how PATCH payloads are represented in Bundle entries.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 12834, which is git commit 0791ecad7f986bc7cc47c91bc5edafcc4facd452. That commit added PATCH to the old Bundle spreadsheet HTTPVerb code list; later source refactoring moved the authoritative artifacts to source/bundle/codesystem-http-verb.xml and source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-19620 narrowed history semantics by saying PATCH-created history entries are represented as PUT and adding bdl-14 to prohibit PATCH when Bundle.type is history. Later Published issue FHIR-33945 accepted Binary for JSON Patch payloads in batch/transaction Bundles after Parameters was discussed, superseding the older JSON/XML Patch-as-Parameters-string documentation detail. The remaining PATCH-history tension with FHIR-34388 is already on the combined branch as a human-review audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already allows PATCH in Bundle.entry.request.method and in transaction/batch Bundle entries, while later accepted decisions govern history representation and JSON Patch transaction payload encoding.

related_jiras.note: Published issue says PATCH creates history entries represented as PUT and added bdl-14 prohibiting PATCH in history Bundles.
